map.UPDRS运动检查部分(Part III)是评估帕金森病运动症状的核心量表，14: The UPDRS Motor Examination (Part III) is the core scale for Parkinson's motor symptoms, 14 items each 0-4, total 0-56. Should be assessed separately in 'on' and 'off' medication states.
map.UPDRS Part III 运动检查总分 = 14 项（每项 0 至 4）之和: UPDRS Part III total = sum of 14 items (each 0-4), max 56; <=10 mild, <=20 moderate, <=30 mod-severe, >30 severe motor impairment; assess in on/off states.
map.UPDRS运动评估应在药物\"开\"期或\"关\"期分别评估: UPDRS motor assessment should be done in "on" or "off" medication states separately
map.建议由经过培训的神经科医师执行: Recommended to be performed by trained neurologists
map.是调整药物和评估DBS手术指征的重要依据: Important basis for medication adjustment and DBS surgery indication
map.帕金森等运动障碍评估。: Parkinson's and other movement disorder assessment.
map.14 项合计 30 /56：明显运动障碍，提示中重度受累。: 14 items total 30 /56: marked motor impairment, suggests mod-severe involvement.
map.与 UPDRS 第三部分等运动量表思路一致，适合纵向随访。: Same concept as UPDRS Part III motor scale, suitable for longitudinal follow-up.
map.UPDRS运动检查部分涵盖言语、僵直、震颤、运动迟缓、姿势稳定性等14项检查，每: UPDRS Motor Examination covers 14 items (speech, rigidity, tremor, bradykinesia, postural stability), each 0-4, total 0-56. It is an important basis for PD medication adjustment and DBS surgery evaluation.
